findings.title: Pinned toggle loses functional-updater safety
findings.problem: handleToggleSection('pinned') captures a stale closure value for shouldExpand instead of using the functional updater form.
findings.impact: Pinned section can silently fail to alternate on rapid double-fire; asymmetric with FocusedChatSidebar.tsx.
findings.recommendation: Keep the functional updater form and read the resulting value from its callback before calling setPersistedSidebarSection.

findings.title: Focused drilldown never updates for a later chat in the same session
findings.problem: hasInitializedFocusedViewRef.current only resets on enteredFocusedView, not on currentChat change.
findings.impact: Drilldown keeps showing the previous chat's location after a page change while staying in Focused mode.
findings.recommendation: Also reset hasInitializedFocusedViewRef.current when currentChat?.id changes.

findings.title: Focused-view drilldown can lock onto data resolved before chats finish loading
findings.problem: Focused-view branch resolves purely on currentChat truthiness, locking hasInitializedFocusedViewRef.current=true before chatLocations finishes loading.
findings.impact: Drilldown can resolve to 'root' instead of the real folder and never retry.
findings.recommendation: Gate the focused-view branch's first resolution on isChatsLoading, matching the unified branch.

findings.title: revealChat's documented folder fallback can never match
findings.problem: Fallback keys folderElementsRef (folder names) by chatId — disjoint id spaces.
findings.impact: Fallback scroll-to-folder silently no-ops instead of degrading gracefully.
findings.recommendation: Look up the chat's actual folder key and fall back using that key.

findings.title: Unified-view Pinned persisted-init has no test
findings.problem: No test exercises the persisted isPinnedExpanded initializer for the unified view.
findings.impact: A regression reverting this initializer would ship silently.
findings.recommendation: Add a test asserting isPinnedExpanded starts false when persisted state is mocked false.

findings.title: Sidebar section prefs cache the anonymous bucket before auth resolves
findings.problem: Storage keyed on userStore.user?.userId ?? '' read via lazy useState initializer at mount, before userStore.loadUser() resolves.
findings.impact: Sidebar mounted before auth resolves mixes anonymous-bucket prefs with the real user's, no later re-sync.
findings.recommendation: Guard on userStore.user?.userId being present; re-read once real userId becomes available.

findings.title: Auto-scroll-into-view effect has no test through real DOM registration
findings.problem: Reveal effect only reachable through real ref registration; all tests mock ChatList to a stub that never calls registerChatElement.
findings.impact: Breaking the reveal effect would ship silently with no test catching it.
findings.recommendation: Add an integration test rendering with a real ChatList registering a chat element, asserting scrollIntoView is called.

findings.title: Reveal guard never retries a chat whose row wasn't ready
findings.problem: revealedChatIdRef marks an id as revealed before confirming the element actually resolved; never reset on remount.
findings.impact: If the row isn't registered in time, or DOM is torn down and rebuilt, the reveal is permanently skipped.
findings.recommendation: Only mark revealedChatIdRef as done once an element actually resolves; reset on registration change.

finding_status.notes: Functional-updater form restored at useChatSidebarExpansion.ts:79-83; test proves two synchronous toggles each flip the real previous value.
hasInitializedFocusedViewRef now resets on currentChat?.id change (line 121-124), independent of the focused/unified edge; dedicated test covers it.
Lock only sets once !isChatsLoading (line 129); dedicated retry test covers the partial-result case.
revealChat now resolves the chat's own folder key from chatLocations/focusedViewModel before falling back (line 114); test proves it ignores an unrelated folder sharing the chat id.
useChatSidebarPagination.test.ts adds direct coverage for the persisted isPinnedExpanded initializer (true and false).

getPersistedSidebarSections/setPersistedSidebarSection guarded on userStore.user?.userId; useResyncPersistedSidebarSections wired into Pinned, Recent, and Recent Assistants; tests cover pre-auth no-read/no-write and post-auth resync.
New integration test in ChatSidebarLists.test.tsx mocks ChatList to register real DOM elements via registerChatElement and asserts scrollIntoView fires.
revealedChatIdRef only locks on revealChat reporting found=true (line 150-151); dedicated test proves a late-registering row is retried.
